subject: general
question: Which country won the Women's T20 Asia Cup 2022 for cricket?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India defeated Sri Lanka by **8 wickets** in the finals of the** Women’s Asia Cup 2022**.
 
• India has bagged the position for the **7th time**.
 
• Sri Lanka won the toss and opted to bat first.
 
• Sri Lanka made 65 runs in 20 overs losing 10 wickets. India chased the target in 8.3 overs making 71 runs with a loss of only 2 wickets.
 
• **Smriti Mandhana** made 51 runs not out in 25 balls.
 
• **Renuka Singh Thakur** claimed three wickets against Sri Lanka while Rajeshwari Gayakwad and Sneh Rana claimed two wickets each.
 
• The final match of India vs Sri Lanka Asia Cup 2022 took place in** Sylhet International Cricket Stadium**, Sylhet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The International Cricket Council (ICC), the international governing body of Cricket founded in 1909 by representatives from England, Australia, and South Africa, was initially known as Imperial Cricket Conference__.
 
• In 1965, it was renamed as International Cricket Conference and in 1965, it was renamed the International Cricket Council (ICC) in 1989.
 
• This council organizes various world championships and tournaments.
 
• ODI World Cup and T-20 World Cup are world-famous.
 
• There are 104 member nations.
 
• Headquarters of ICC - Dubai, UAE
 
• Motto - Cricket for good
 
• Chairman - Greg Barclay
